pages.title: TRACE-E Exploring the WEB-Quarters Control Room Coloring Page
pages.description: TRACE-E explores the WEB-Quarters control room in this printable coloring page, with six jointed legs, a smiling face, and a spider emblem on its side. A web-patterned window rises behind the robot beside a console with round buttons. Curved wall panels and the large face divide this coloring sheet into clear enclosed sections.

pages.title: Green Goblin Riding His Glider with a Pumpkin Coloring Page
pages.description: Green Goblin rides his glider in this printable coloring page, holding a jack-o-lantern beside his pointed cap, shoulder armor, bent knees, and broad boots. His free hand grips the glider's raised handle above its angular face. A rooftop and two cloud outlines keep the flying figure prominent without crowding the open costume sections.

pages.title: Electro Raising Her Electric Gauntlet Coloring Page
pages.description: Electro raises her electric gauntlet in this printable coloring page, clenching a fist beside outlined lightning bolts, a pointed mask, and a high ponytail. A round lightning emblem marks the gauntlet, with matching bolt shapes across her suit and boots. Small rooftop blocks sit behind the full figure, leaving wide areas inside the costume.

pages.title: Team Spidey Facing Doc Ock's Mechanical Whale Coloring Page
pages.description: Team Spidey faces Doc Ock's mechanical whale in this printable coloring page, with Spidey, Spin, and Ghost-Spider crouching beneath its large fins and segmented tail. Doc Ock operates controls from an open cockpit, surrounded by four mechanical tentacles. Rounded body panels, rivets, and curved belly sections add machinery details above the heroes' patterned suits.

pages.title: Spidey Trapping Electro in Glow Webs Coloring Page
pages.description: Spidey traps Electro in Glow Webs in this printable coloring page, pulling two web strands around her torso beside a large gauntlet and pointed mask. Electro's ponytail and lightning-marked boots remain visible above the rooftop. The crossing webs create narrow enclosed sections between the larger suit panels and full standing figures on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Spidey and Ghost-Spider Stopping a Pumpkin Float Coloring Page
pages.description: Spidey and Ghost-Spider stop Green Goblin's Halloween pumpkin float in this printable coloring page, pulling web strands around its giant jack-o-lantern above two large wheels. Green Goblin holds the steering wheel from the platform above the pumpkin. Smaller hanging pumpkin faces, garlands, and a nearby building add details around the heroes' web-pulling poses.
